title: Company milestones
goal: Show a company history from founding to the present in clearly labelled eras.

rubric.must: Founding, Growth, and Platform eras are visibly separated across the timeline.
Founding, financing, user-growth, platform launch, and AI-suite milestone events appear in chronological order.
A present operating-plan event is visibly placed at the end of the timeline.
Founding, financing, user-growth, and AI-suite events use visually stronger milestone markers.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 满足两个 blocker，并清楚呈现末端 operating-plan、重点 milestone 标记和可读日期；Image 2 缺少规定的 era 与关键事件。
